name: cdn-sni-block-ech
description: A reassembling box resets any TLS ClientHello that names the publisher's CDN host, on every address. A hello with ECH shows only the shared outer name cloudflare-ech.com and passes; a plain hello for the zone is caught. The direct families never show that name and pass. Op cdn: the CDN route carries with ECH, and the censor never sees the zone's name in a hello (no plain fallback, owner decision D-2).
analogue: An SNI blocklist entry for a CDN-fronted hostname learned from a captured pack (plan §2.2, 'a censor holding a pack can block the zone by SNI on networks where ECH fails'); the GFW-style reassembling SNI reset. Model: exact name, full reassembly, RST both ways. Not modelled: ECH being stripped or blocked in transit (cdn-ech-outer-block), JA3/JA4 of the ECH hello.
